title: Carry the original request when retrying a retry
summary: Fix `earlier_attempt` in reading.rs so that retrying a job that was itself a retry carries the original request, found by following the chain with loop protection. Per the user's reply, nothing else is done: no review-1 response and no design revision.

defaults_applied.how: Only the retry fix, as the user asked.
Add a retry-of-retry test; cargo test and clippy stay clean.
The user's reply settles scope; the remaining details are decided by the producer.
Carried text, including the original request, is redacted.

assumptions: Scope is only the earlier_attempt fix in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs; the review-1 response and design revision are out of scope per the user's reply.
The user's remark that the 8 decisions are answered needs no action in this job.
The original request is found by following 'try again on <id>' requests back to the first job that is not a retry.

acceptance_criteria.text: Retrying a retry: A rejected, B ('try again on A') rejected, C asked 'try again on B' gets an Earlier attempt whose request contains A's original request text, and B's findings still appear. New test in crates/athena-cli/tests/lifecycle.rs (or reading.rs unit tests); run `cargo test`.
A single retry (A not itself a retry) yields the same brief as before; existing retry tests pass. Run `cargo test`.
Errors unchanged: unknown job, non-rejected job, and bare 'try again on' are still refused with an error naming the job. Run `cargo test`.
Everything carried, including the original request, passes through the redactor; a test shows it. `cargo test`, `cargo clippy`, `cargo fmt --check` are clean.
Following the chain cannot loop forever or panic: a visited-id set or depth bound is used, and a code comment says which.
CHANGELOG.md [Unreleased] records the retry fix. No design doc, review response, or governance file is changed.
